description: Create or update the root `.gitignore` for a Go repository — the command-line tool layout `iru-setup-go-cli` produces (`go.mod`, `cmd/<bin>/`, `internal/`, `tools/gendocs`, `testdata/script/`) or any other Go module — covering the binary `go build` leaves at the root (`/<bin>`, `/<bin>.exe`, root-anchored so `cmd/<bin>/` stays tracked), test binaries and profiles (`*.test`, `*.pprof`), coverage output (`coverage.out`, `*.coverprofile`, `coverage.html`, a `/covdata/` GOCOVERDIR), the `build/` report/docs-generator directory (`build/coverage/cover.out`, `build/gendocs/`), GoReleaser's `dist/`, per-developer `go.work`/`go.work.sum` (unless the repository deliberately tracks a workspace), `/vendor/` only when dependencies are not vendored (asked), env files (keeping `.env.example`), the Antora docs build output, editor/OS files, the repository-wide `.integration-test.lock/`, and — for a Bubble Tea terminal UI — the UI tests' capture directory `.ui-screenshots/` (never `.ui-quality.yml`). Never ignores `go.mod`, `go.sum`, `testdata/` or `.secrets.baseline`. Invoke as `/iru-setup-go-gitignore`, optionally with `args` (`key: value` lines): `bin-name` (default: every `cmd/<name>/` directory, else the module path's last element), `vendor: yes|no`, `mode: new|existing` (default: detected) and `on-existing: ask|keep|update|replace` (default `ask`). Announces whether it is creating from scratch or updating; an existing `.gitignore` is never overwritten silently — it warns, shows a diff, and asks Update (merge in what's missing, keep hand-added lines) / Keep as is / Replace, unless `on-existing` decides. Use whenever a Go repository needs a `.gitignore` bootstrapped from scratch, or an existing one checked and gap-filled against this house template.
